sources.excerpt: Outlaw Effects Dead Man's Hand 2-Mode Overdrive - Pedal of the Day Reviews Demos Buy a Pedalboard Interviews Contact Navigation Menu Menu Outlaw Effects Dead Man’s Hand 2-Mode Overdrive Posted By Pedal of the Day on Sunday, July 12, 2015 in Outlaw Effects, Overdrive / Distortion | 0 comments --> --> Continuing our run of reviews for the smallest, baddest, pint-sized pedals in the West, today we’ve got the Dead Man’s Hand 2-Mode Overdrive from our friends Outlaw Effects. This small but powerful drive makes a perfect pair with any pedalboard, and has a few surprises up its sleeve (see what I did there?) as well. Tone, Level and Gain are the three basic overdrive controls here on the Dead Man’s Hand , and they function exactly like they should. The Gain provides a nice tonal sweep, and will do clean boost up to a nice, warm but dirty gritty drive sound. There are two distinct modes that this pedal will run in as well, accessible and switchable via a toggle in the middle top of the pedal. Eights Mode is geared towards the more typical mid-range drive sound, while the Aces Mode beefs everything up a bit, for a hotter, louder and more potent sonic attack on your amp, with a big fat dose of sustain for good measure. Both modes are very useful for many styles of music, while getting chunky without moving into super hi-gain, screeching treble-town territory, and work in conjunction with the Gain and Tone knobs for a vast array of textures and sounds. Basic, little, space-saving and full of power, the Dead Man’s Hand 2-Mode Overdrive is another classic pedal coming out of the Outlaw Effects ‘ camp. These couple of pedals of theirs we’ve reviewed have been quite impressive, and we can’t wait to get our hands on some more! If you’re in the market for a nice-sounding drive with a couple of cool options and real estate-saving dimensions, look no further than the Dead Man’s Hand.
